about:
Founded in 1985, Aurora Power & Design Inc. has operated from Boise, Idaho for nearly four decades, establishing itself as one of the oldest renewable energy companies in the country. The business remains at its original location on North 36th Street, serving the Treasure Valley region.

The company provides turnkey solar energy systems for both residential and commercial clients, supplying photovoltaic panels, battery banks, micro-hydropower turbines, and backup generator connections. Its offerings encompass site assessment, system design, equipment procurement, and installation, though Aurora does not fabricate the components it sells.

The client base consists primarily of homeowners and local businesses in southwestern Idaho seeking grid-tied or off-grid electricity generation. The firm promotes its services to property owners aiming to lower monthly utility costs or achieve energy self-sufficiency.

Aurora cites its 35-plus years in the solar industry and a holistic design methodology — matching equipment to a site’s specific layout and sun exposure — as its primary differentiators. The company also stresses that it keeps customers updated with the most modern, efficient solar power equipment available.
